subject: Science
question_text: Explain the process of photosynthesis and its importance.

criteria.name: Definition
criteria.description: Defines photosynthesis correctly using appropriate terms
criteria.model_answer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight, water and CO2 to produce glucose and oxygen.

criteria.name: Equation
criteria.description: Writes the correct chemical or word equation

criteria.name: Importance
criteria.description: Explains at least two roles of photosynthesis in the ecosystem
criteria.model_answer: Produces oxygen for respiration; forms the base of the food chain by producing organic matter.

subject: Social Science
question_text: Describe the causes and consequences of the French Revolution.

criteria.name: Political Causes
criteria.description: Identifies at least two political causes such as absolute monarchy and weak leadership
criteria.model_answer: Absolute monarchy under Louis XVI; lack of representative government; Estates system.

criteria.name: Economic Causes
criteria.description: Describes the financial crisis, taxation of the poor and food shortages
criteria.model_answer: France was bankrupt; heavy taxes on the Third Estate; crop failures and bread prices.

criteria.name: Social Causes
criteria.description: Explains the role of Enlightenment ideas and class inequality
criteria.model_answer: Enlightenment ideas of liberty and equality; resentment of aristocratic privilege.

criteria.name: Consequences
criteria.description: Describes at least two major consequences including abolition of monarchy and Declaration of Rights
criteria.model_answer: Abolition of feudalism; Declaration of Rights of Man; execution of Louis XVI; rise of Napoleon.
